sources.note: The drawing supports eight Ø3,4 THRU ALL holes at R115,5 with top-opening Ø6,9 X 90° countersinks. The countersink geometry fits both documented thickness alternatives. Verification: The callout '8 x Ø3,4 THRU ALL' with the countersink symbol 'Ø6,9 X 90°' and the R115,5 leader to a hole center support 8 countersunk through-holes on a 115.5 radius. The main view shows holes at the +X, +Y, -X and -Y positions on the centerlines and four more on the diagonals. With the center at the concentric origin, this matches a circle pattern with start_angle 0 and 360/8 = 45° spacing. In the face-on view each hole shows a visible solid outer countersink rim, so the countersink opens toward the +Z viewer, which is the top face. The countersink depth is (6.9-3.4)/2 = 1.75 at 90°, so it fits both the 2,0 and 3,0 thickness options. All numbers cite matching printed values.
